t.zh: 在真值电路里，<level-ref to="g-iff"></level-ref>的 ↔ 表示同真同假。在证明核里，A ↔ B 就是「(A → B) ∧ (B → A)」：两个方向的 → 都成立。
t.en: In the truth circuits, the ↔ of <level-ref to="g-iff"></level-ref> meant true together and false together. In the kernel, A ↔ B is “(A → B) ∧ (B → A)”: the → holds both ways.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref>也能拆 ↔：拆出两个方向的「若…则…」，用对的那一个。
hint.en: <part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref> splits ↔ too: into the two “if … then …”s; use the right one.

hint.zh: 这回要用另一个方向：假设「我休息」，看能不能撞出矛盾。
hint.en: This time it takes the other direction: assume “I rest” and see whether it runs into a contradiction.
